共同操作

A1

操作记录：6a (0.10 mmol), Pd catalyst (5 mol%), ligand (12 mol%), base (0.2 mmol), reported solvent (0.03 M), reported temperature/time；步骤 1：stirred/heated under reported conditions

A2

通法出处：doc_0341d857f4f70e0f:general_synthesis_THBC_1；操作记录：Allenamide 6 (1.0 equiv), iodide 7 (1.3 equiv), Pd2(dba)3 (0.05 equiv), t-Bu-XantPhos (0.12 equiv), Ag2CO3 (2.0 equiv), DMF, argon, 80 °C, 1 h；步骤 1：stirred/heated under reported conditions

A3

操作记录：1aa (1.0 equiv), base (2.0 equiv) or oxidant (3.0 equiv; entry 9 uses 2.0 equiv), reported solvent/temperature/time; argon except entries 1–2；步骤 1：stirred/heated under reported conditions

A4

通法出处：doc_0341d857f4f70e0f:general_synthesis_beta_carbolines_2；操作记录：THBC 1 (1.0 equiv), DDQ (3.0 equiv), toluene, 100 °C, reported time；步骤 1：stirred/heated under reported conditions

A5

通法出处：doc_0341d857f4f70e0f:general_synthesis_spiroindolenines_9；操作记录：6h (1.0 equiv), iodide 7 (1.1 equiv), Pd(PPh3)4 (0.05 equiv), PCy3 (0.12 equiv), Cs2CO3 (4.0 equiv), dry DMF, argon, 100 °C, reported time；步骤 1：stirred/heated under reported conditions

A6

通法出处：doc_0341d857f4f70e0f:general_synthesis_S2；步骤 1：K2CO3 was added to S1 in acetone under nitrogen, followed by 3-bromopropyne；步骤 2：heated to reflux until TLC completion；步骤 3：quenched/extracted, washed, dried, and concentrated as reported；步骤 4：silica-gel column chromatography; eluent 25–35% ethyl acetate–petroleum ether (v/v)

A7

通法出处：doc_0341d857f4f70e0f:general_synthesis_S3；步骤 1：cooled to 0 °C; NaH and alkylating agent were added successively；步骤 2：held after additions before warming；步骤 3：allowed to reach room temperature gradually；步骤 4：stirred at room temperature until TLC completion；步骤 5：quenched with water, extracted with ethyl acetate, washed with brine, dried, and evaporated；步骤 6：silica-gel chromatography with petroleum ether:ethyl acetate = 4:1 (v/v)

A8

通法出处：doc_0341d857f4f70e0f:general_synthesis_allenamides_6；步骤 1：KOtBu was added to S3 in dry THF under argon at ice-cold condition；步骤 2：stirred at room temperature until TLC completion；步骤 3：quenched/extracted, washed, dried, and concentrated as reported；步骤 4：silica-gel column chromatography; eluent 15–20% ethyl acetate/petroleum ether (v/v)
